profile.headline: Software Engineer III
profile.summary: Enthusiastic Full Stack Software Engineer with a focus on data-driven applications. My primary programming languages include Java, Python, and SQL, but I am always open to learning something new. I graduated from the University of California with my Masters degree in Computer Engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Spring software solutions utilizing full stack development methodologies, that assist financial institutions analyze data. These applications streamlined and automated data reconciliation, improving throughput for organizations that would process millions of these transactions daily.
■ Enhanced customer support and QA response times by 20% by implementing a dynamic logging system across microservices.
■ Co-led design and development of a new microservice that was designed to automate the assignment of reconciliation break reasons through the use of machine learning / artificial intelligence models.
■ Optimized machine learning dataset generation, cutting processing time by 90% through rebuilding the file system, standardizing output structure, and tuning SQL queries for performance.
■ Refactored SQL queries for compatibility across Oracle, PostgreSQL, and Microsoft SQL Server.
■Wrote REST APIs for frontend / UI integration, inter-microservice communication, and external application querying.
■ Developed client specific POC software aiming to integrate our application with external services such as Snowflake.
■ Enhanced query efficiency by reducing the size of key tables by 50% through an application-wide data archival system that migrated outdated rows to long-term storage.
■ Applied software engineering best practices in development of features and corresponding unit tests and integration tests to ensure reliability and reduce potential regression.
■ Demonstrated strong communication skills through collaboration with cross functional teams and by creating detailed technical documentation of implemented features.

positions.title: Game Programmer
positions.description:
Commissioned to develop mods for numerous game's using the game's modding API.

Team Fortress 2
■ Implemented a Halo “Oddball” style game mode with a custom map. This included a supplemental SourcePawn mod that hooked the Halo announcer to in-game events.

Minecraft & Don't Starve
■ Introduced new elements and characteristics to the game in the form of custom items.

positions.title: Resident Office Associate
positions.description:
Provided technical support for the computer lab's in the residential halls.

■ Ensured residential computer labs operated with peak uptime by maintaining the computer lab's equipment and network while generating lab status reports.
■ Set up multimedia equipment for residential events.
■ Diagnosed and repaired issues with the personal computers using practical analysis for a community of thousands.

projects.title: Twitter Crawler and Index Search
projects.description:
The first half of this project was a Java Twitter crawler that was designed to capture tweets and store its components (user, text, hashtags, geolocation) in a JSON format.
The second half was an Apache Lucene index for those tweets implemented in Java with a HTML and Javascript Frontend.
The Lucene index was capable of ranking the tweets based on the relevance of its components, allowing for a refined search.

projects.title: Autonomous Ground Vehicle
projects.description:
Our team designed an autonomous ground vehicle that was capable of self navigation using ultrasonic sensors using a Raspberry Pi and an Arduino Uno.
Also, the vehicle was capable of remotely receiving commands as well as relay video back to the controlling computer.
The Autonomous Ground Vehicle was designed using Python with Pygame to control the Raspberry Pi and control program; the Arduino Uno controlling
the sensors and motors was implemented using C/C++.
As team lead, I was coordinated team members to ensure each component was completed and tested on schedule.
Additionally, I designed and programmed the wireless communication system used to transmit and receive controls and video as well as
refined the inter-device communication between the Raspberry Pi and Arduino Uno.
